SEARCH
Package controllers

Class ApplicationController

java.lang.Object
play.mvc.Results
play.mvc.Controller
controllers.ApplicationController
All Implemented Interfaces:
play.mvc.Http.HeaderNames, play.mvc.Http.Status
public class ApplicationController extends play.mvc.Controller
Handles browser requests and delegates application work to services.

AI assistance: implementation support for the Phase 2 request for one asynchronous controller and a tested home page; Phase 6 search and error UI; Phase 7 pagination; Phase 8 cached readability and details; Phase 9 word statistics.

Author:
Nabeel Ali
